name: Marcus Webb
description: Overnight security guard on duty at Valcourt BioLabs the night Dr. Rask disappeared. Responsible for monitoring the lobby and corridor camera feeds from the ground-floor security office. Initially reluctant to speak with investigators — worried about losing his job over the corrupted Level 3 feed.

relationships.description: Nodding acquaintance. Signed Dr. Rask in most evenings.
Claims not to recognize the unidentified man from the lobby footage.
